title: Lookup-Table Augmented Balanced Search Tree for Approximation Correction in C#
topic: Using a lookup-table to correct an approximation
description: We present a lightweight augmentation of a height-balanced binary search tree that uses a precomputed lookup table to correct the deterministic approximation...
abstract: We present a lightweight augmentation of a height-balanced binary search tree that uses a precomputed lookup table to correct the deterministic approximation introduced by lazy node rebalancing. The lookup table stores canonical key-to-node mappings for a fixed set of frequently queried keys, enabling constant-time resolution of approximate search results. We formally prove that the augmented structure preserves the strict height-balance invariant and the key-ordered invariant, and we show that point and range queries retain an asymptotic bound of $O(\log N)$. The implementation is written in C\# and is available under a permissive license. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/csharp-enterprise-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261022_130119_using_a_lookup-table_to_correc}
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints
